title: Birlanu Ltd - 509675 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: BirlaNu India business revenue rose 17.3% to Rs 588 crore with EBITDA of Rs 40 crore (6.8% margin), while Parador's Rs 90 crore extra provision weighed on consolidated results.
summary.overview: India business (standalone plus Clean Coats) delivered its third straight quarter of double-digit revenue growth, with EBITDA up from Rs 12 crore to Rs 40 crore and margin up over 400 bps to 6.8%. Consolidated revenue grew 9.2% to Rs 885 crore, but Parador's operating losses led to an additional Rs 90 crore investment provision (cumulative Rs 164 crore) booked as an exceptional item in standalone accounts. Management stated confidence in H2 and a strong FY27, while Parador remained the main focus of analyst pushback. Total debt rose to Rs 896 crore from Rs 852 crore at March 31, driven by greenfield capex.

financial_highlights.change: from Rs 12 crore; margin up over 400 bps YoY
from Rs 69 crore; margin up over 400 bps
cumulative Rs 164 crore as of Sep 30, 2026; booked as exceptional item in standalone

segments.name: Roofs
segments.commentary: Revenue Rs 244 crore, +28% YoY, volume +21%; EBITDA margin 11.5% vs 8.3% (+320 bps). Value-added mix up 35% YoY; a value enhancement programme is expected to deliver full annual benefit from next year.

segments.name: Walls
segments.commentary: Revenue Rs 164 crore, +5.4% YoY; volume +1-2%, realisation +5-9%. EBITDA margin 12.3%, +120 bps YoY (over 200 bps QoQ). Capacity utilisation about 85%.

segments.name: Pipes
segments.commentary: Revenue Rs 132 crore, +20% YoY: about 4% volume and 15% pricing/mix. EBITDA margin improved 630 bps to about 5%. Value-added products including fittings at 47% of portfolio.

segments.name: Construction Chemicals
segments.commentary: Revenue up about 35% YoY; Clean Coats revenue up about 50% YoY but raw material costs weigh on margins. Management says demand currently exceeds production capacity at Clean Coats.

segments.name: Putty
segments.commentary: Revenue declined about 17% in the quarter, attributed to Diwali timing shift by a month; management says like-for-like flat and that it is in hold-and-maintain mode.

segments.name: Parador (Europe flooring)
segments.commentary: Revenue down 11% in local currency and about 4% in INR; operating losses. H1 EBITDA-positive target not yet met; Q2 revenue ~EUR60m in H1 per analyst. Investment provision cumulative Rs 164 crore.

guidance_outlook: Management expects a strong H2 and a strong FY27 in aggregate, citing portfolio mix, new capacity and execution.
Parador: first milestone is to be EBITDA-positive in H2 FY27; management did not confirm full-year EBITDA positivity. Early signs of revenue rebound since October.

BCG cost programme at Parador identified EUR9-14m annual EBITDA value envelope (internal takeouts, discounted for timing); results expected to show within 3-4 months. Management says it would cut Parador monthly breakeven by about EUR1m.

Solar: rooftop/solar capacity commissioned at Goindwal/Chennai units (Golan in transcript); approved at 2 more units; green power expected to exceed 20-25% of energy mix within 2 years. Existing-footprint savings Rs 4-5 crore annually over 6-9 months.
Nellore greenfield boards plant to start commercial production in Q4 FY27; Hyderabad project groundbreaking by December 2026.
Clean Coats integration expected to complete by end of calendar 2026, subject to statutory approvals.

Long-term target: Walls to reach about Rs 1,000 crore revenue from about Rs 500 crore; Pipes and Construction Chemicals targeting 3-4x of year-ago base. Non-European sales below 10% of Parador value; target above 20% within 3 years.
capex_capacity: Nellore greenfield boards plant on track for commercial production in Q4 FY27.
Second new project in Hyderabad: groundbreaking expected by December 2026.
Debt increase from Rs 852 crore to Rs 896 crore attributed to greenfield and capacity expansion capex.
Walls capacity utilisation about 85% across products.
Clean Coats: demand exceeds current production capacity as of late October/early November.
demand_pricing: Roofs: industry tailwinds from pent-up price correction after 2-3 years of cost inflation and steel roofing price increases shifting demand to BirlaNu.
Pipes: Q1 industry degrowth due to volatile resin prices; Q2 growth mostly price/mix; management says some competitors chased volume at the expense of margin; Agri mix affected volume reporting.

Parador: European demand weak; management cites a 12-15 month rise in new house permits and constructions in Germany/Europe, with flooring demand expected to lag 12-18 months. Market share gains claimed in DIY chains (Bauhaus, OBI, DM references).
Raw material, energy, freight and currency inflation from geopolitical situation; management warns high inflation, tight liquidity and El Nino could weigh on rural and near-term demand.
Analyst observed Parador has made 23 financial commitments over 11 calls since 2019, with 21 missed (analyst view).

qa_highlights.question: Parador: is EUR80m H2 revenue achievable to reach EBITDA breakeven, and when will the turnaround be visible?
qa_highlights.answer: BCG engagement identified EUR9-14m EBITDA value; first milestone is H2 EBITDA positivity to offset H1 losses. Results expected within 3-4 months; North America sales in 6 months nearly 2x full prior year.

qa_highlights.question: Pipes growth reconciliation: 20% vs 16% segment figure, and volume vs price split?
qa_highlights.answer: The gap is Putty, down about 17% due to Diwali timing; Pipes growth ~20% of which ~4% volume and ~15% pricing/mix; inventory gains marginal; EBITDA margin near 5%.

qa_highlights.question: Parador exposure and why support is rising while provisions are taken?
qa_highlights.answer: Total exposure EUR40m: EUR20m SBLC and EUR20m corporate guarantee. Management says the amount largely reflects acquisition financing; the provision reverses if Parador generates cash flow.

qa_highlights.question: Polymer division losses at EBIT level and Putty profitability?
qa_highlights.answer: Management says Putty is just above breakeven; Pipes profitability improved; Construction Chemicals investing in channel; Polymer EBIT burdened by about Rs 40 crore annual depreciation per CFO.

qa_highlights.question: Will the portfolio company or Parador be hived off?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said now is not the time to hive off, though all portfolio options are actively evaluated.

qa_highlights.question: Scope and budget of the new AI-enabled materials discovery platform?
qa_highlights.answer: Asset-light; first approval about Rs 5 crore over 12-18 months; a subsidiary was approved at the board meeting the previous day.

risks_watch: Parador: continued operating losses, further provisions (cumulative Rs 164 crore), and guarantee/SBLC exposure of EUR40m; analysts question the turnaround timeline and whether to exit.
Whether H2 Parador EBITDA turns positive and BCG savings of EUR9-14m land on the bottom line.
Raw material and energy inflation, geopolitical and freight disruptions affecting margins in Pipes, Clean Coats and Parador.
Demand risk from high inflation, tight liquidity and possible El Nino impact on rural demand.
Rising debt (Rs 896 crore) to fund greenfield projects; Nellore Q4 FY27 commissioning and Hyderabad timing.
Clean Coats integration completion by end CY2026 subject to statutory approvals.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the India business and H2 outlook, but defensive and evasive on Parador: management repeatedly deferred on timelines, the provision outcome and the support rationale, and declined to discuss hive-off or promoter stake questions.
key_quotes: The revenue for our India business grew by 17% to Rs. 588 crores, and this is now the third consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth.
We are acting decisively to reset the business for recovery.
As we exit October, enter November, we are at a stage where there is more demand than we can service out of our production facility.
As far as the question of hiving off etc. is concerned, we do not think now is the time to do it.

adds.what: Second greenfield project in Hyderabad (groundbreaking by Dec 2026)
Rooftop/solar capacity commissioned at Goindwal/Chennai units

growth.why: Management expects a strong H2 and strong FY27 in aggregate, backed by the Nellore boards plant (commercial production Q4 FY27), Clean Coats demand exceeding capacity, and a 6.8% India EBITDA margin, but no explicit revenue growth % was given and Parador remains loss-making with only a H2 EBITDA-positive milestone.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: India EBITDA margin rose to 6.8% in Q2 from about 2.8% a year ago (Rs 40 cr on Rs 588 cr), Roofs margin 11.5% (+320 bps) and Walls 12.3%, with BCG Parador savings of EUR9-14m and Rs 4-5 cr solar savings, offset by raw material, energy and freight inflation.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Nellore greenfield boards plant is on track for commercial production in Q4 FY27 and Clean Coats demand already exceeds production capacity, though no capacity size was disclosed.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Roofs volume grew 21% and Pipes volume about 4%, but Walls volume was only 1-2% and Putty fell about 17% on Diwali timing; management guided a strong H2 without an explicit volume percentage.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Walls utilisation is about 85% and Hyderabad second greenfield groundbreaking is due by Dec 2026, but both projects are already approved, so a fresh capex announcement is not clearly signalled.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management expects a strong H2 and strong FY27 in aggregate with India EBITDA up from Rs 12 cr to Rs 40 cr YoY, but gave no explicit numeric revenue or margin guidance to raise.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Parador has missed prior commitments (analyst count 21 of 23 missed), its H1 EBITDA-positive target was not met, and cumulative provisions reached Rs 164 cr, with inflation and El Nino risks to rural demand.

rows.label: Parador EBITDA-positive in H2 FY27
rows.why: First milestone is H2 EBITDA positivity, with BCG savings of EUR9-14m and monthly breakeven cut by about EUR1m, but H1 target was missed and full-year positivity was not confirmed.

rows.label: Clean Coats integration completion
rows.why: Management expects completion by end of calendar 2026, subject to statutory approvals, and Clean Coats revenue already grew about 50% YoY.

rows.label: Debt rising on greenfield capex
rows.why: Total debt rose to Rs 896 cr from Rs 852 cr since March 31 to fund greenfield projects, so net debt is more likely to keep rising than fall in the window.

tone.note: Management was confident on the India business, H2 outlook and Nellore timing, but defensive and evasive on Parador's timelines, provision outcome and support rationale; analysts pushed hard on Parador's missed commitments and whether to exit.
